## Activity

North City Eye Clinic completed 503 retinal image captures during February 2026. The activity recorded for the month was reviewed against the associated image quality and grading outcomes. The available results indicate that the clinic continued to provide a regular flow of images for assessment during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 503 captures, 12 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.4 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result has been recorded for routine monitoring of image quality at the site. No further interpretation is assigned to the ungradable images in this report.

## Grading

Grading identified 154 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This measure indicates the typical interval between the image being captured and the grading outcome being recorded. The results should be considered alongside the image quality outcome, including the 12 ungradable captures.

Staff raised no new equipment faults during February 2026. Overall, the monthly activity, image quality, and grading information has been documented for North City Eye Clinic.
